description: Part 10 lesson 10-04 checkpoint (issue #11, design part10-design-v3 H4). Everything is created in the dev library and removed again; the private library is never touched. Order of the harness: file, sh (before), ONE cl wrapper job, sh (after), collect. BEFORE: precondition check that JUCSRV and ZAISRV exist in the dev library (CHKOBJ, the 09-04 routines register them by name); the 09-04 routine script src/sql/09-04-routines.sql, db/mock/apimock.sql and solutions/10-04/lowstock-alert.sql are run with RUNSQLSTM SRCSTMF NAMING(*SQL) DFTRDBCOL (the route verified in 09-04/09-05, no iconv). RUNLOWALQ (review addition): if lowstock-alert.sql left no LOWALERT view (for example SQL0204 on the unqualified LOW_STOCK call at CREATE time), the same view is created through db2 with the library written out, and the marker LOWALERT-missing-running-qualified-fallback shows in the output, so the later steps still run; the outcome of the unqualified file is then read from the RUNLOWAL print. The promotion sub-step deletes a service program in the dev library only when its backup copy in the backup library exists (CHKOBJ, otherwise skip to the copy-back). WRAPPER (one job, all names qualified): counts before; JUCHU_INQUIRY_JSON for J00001 (and for a missing order) into VFY1004; LOW_STOCK rows (expect P00002 and P00005); the LOWALERT view from the same job, and the empty case as a WHERE 1 = 0 copy (records whether items is null or an empty array, UNVERIFIED); JUHTTPSV compile and the five mock calls 1000001 OK, 9999999 OK/results null, 9999504 HTTPERR, 9999404 HTTPERR, 1234567 NOMOCK, snapshot of APILOG; promotion sub-step: CRTDUPOBJ of ZAISRV and JUCSRV to the backup library (ZAISRVP, JUCSRVP), DLTSRVPGM in the dev library, CRTDUPOBJ back (delete first, CRTDUPOBJ has no REPLACE), CHKOBJ with a copy-back fallback (the design says promote from the dev source; this batch never reads the private library, so the round trip through the backup library stands in for it); TXCKM rows for lesson 10-04 (JUHTTPSV *PGM, APIMOCK *FILE, ZAISRV *SRVPGM, JUCSRV *SRVPGM) and ONE TXCHECK run via TXCHKRUN (CPF4174 on a second call in the same job, 08-08). No RPG-backed SQL function is called in the wrapper (only SQL routines and the adapter). AFTER (each system or db2 call is its own job): JUCHU_REGISTER with J09901 as ONE text literal (no JSON_OBJECT with numbers), round trip through JUCHU_INQUIRY_JSON, the duplicate call (expect SQLSTATE 75001 and header/detail counts unchanged); parse-zip.sql then validate-zip.sql (ZIPCHECK over APIMOCK, ZIPCHKLOG over APILOG + APIZIP), snapshots; export-json.sql (literal LINE with a relative path, looked for in the home directory; procedure EXPORT_LOWSTOCK with a variable read from the LOWALERT column), the procedure called with an absolute path, IFS_READ_UTF8 read back and parsed with JSON_TABLE in collect, a JSON literal round trip, a scalar subselect directly as LINE, and LINE lengths 3000 and 20000 (UNVERIFIED, results decide the lesson text); SYSROUTINES and OBJECT_STATISTICS before cleanup; cleanup by SPECIFIC name (routines, views, tables APILOG/APIMOCK/APICFG, JUHTTPSV and its source member), J09901..J09903 rows, the TXCKM rows of lesson 10-04 (TXCKM, TXCHECK, TXCHKRUN are shared and stay), the backup copies ZAISRVP/JUCSRVP only if the copy-back object exists, the exported files. COLLECT: VFY1004 rows, JSON parsed back with JSON_TABLE, APILOG snapshot, verdict snapshots, IFS read-back, SYSROUTINES leftovers (expect 0 of the batch routines), objects left, row counts (expect JUCHUM 8, JUCHUD 12, ZAIKOM 6, no J099 rows), TXCKM rows left (expect 0). Nothing here is assumed: every UNVERIFIED item of the design is a step whose outcome is only recorded.

steps.sql: SELECT TAG, ORD, LIB, TYPE FROM &LIB/VFYCUR ORDER BY TAG, ORD
SELECT SEQ, TAG, VAL FROM &LIB/VFY1004 ORDER BY SEQ

SELECT S.SEQ, T.ORDER_NO, T.LINE_NO, T.PRODUCT, T.QTY FROM &LIB/VFY1004 S, JSON_TABLE(CASE WHEN S.TAG = 'INQ-J00001' THEN S.VAL END, 'lax $' COLUMNS(ORDER_NO CHAR(6) PATH 'lax $.orderNo', NESTED PATH 'lax $.lines[*]' COLUMNS(LINE_NO INT PATH 'lax $.line', PRODUCT CHAR(6) PATH 'lax $.product', QTY INT PATH 'lax $.qty'))) AS T WHERE S.TAG = 'INQ-J00001' ORDER BY T.LINE_NO

SELECT S.SEQ, S.TAG, T.CNT, T.PRODUCT, T.STOCK, T.POINT FROM &LIB/VFY1004 S, JSON_TABLE(CASE WHEN S.TAG IN ('ALERT-JSON', 'ALERT-EMPTY') THEN S.VAL END, 'lax $' COLUMNS(CNT INT PATH 'lax $.count', NESTED PATH 'lax $.items[*]' COLUMNS(PRODUCT CHAR(6) PATH 'lax $.product', STOCK INT PATH 'lax $.stock', POINT INT PATH 'lax $.reorderPoint'))) AS T WHERE S.TAG IN ('ALERT-JSON', 'ALERT-EMPTY') ORDER BY S.SEQ, T.PRODUCT
SELECT LOGID, APIMODE, ZIP, RC, HTTPST, RESPLEN, SQLST FROM &LIB/VFYAPILOG ORDER BY LOGID
SELECT ZIP, HTTPST, VERDICT FROM &LIB/VFYZC1 ORDER BY ZIP
SELECT LOGID, ZIP, RC, VERDICT FROM &LIB/VFYZC2 ORDER BY LOGID
SELECT LINE_NUMBER, LENGTH(LINE) AS LEN, CAST(LINE AS VARCHAR(400) CCSID 1208) AS LINE_TXT FROM &LIB/VFYEXP ORDER BY LINE_NUMBER

SELECT S.LINE_NUMBER, T.CNT, T.PRODUCT FROM &LIB/VFYEXP S, JSON_TABLE(S.LINE, 'lax $' COLUMNS(CNT INT PATH 'lax $.count', NESTED PATH 'lax $.items[*]' COLUMNS(PRODUCT CHAR(6) PATH 'lax $.product'))) AS T ORDER BY T.PRODUCT

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ROUTINES_LEFT FROM QSYS2.SYSROUTINES WHERE SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = '&LIB' AND SPECIFIC_NAME IN ('JUCHUINQJS', 'LOWSTOCKT', 'LOWSTOCKRS', 'JUCHUREGST', 'EXPLOWJSN', 'GETSTOCKQT', 'CNTCUSTORD', 'GETCUSTNM')
SELECT ROUTINE_NAME, SPECIFIC_NAME, ROUTINE_TYPE FROM QSYS2.SYSROUTINES WHERE SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = '&LIB' ORDER BY ROUTINE_NAME

SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN ('JUCHUINQJS', 'LOWSTOCKT', 'LOWSTOCKRS', 'JUCHUREGST', 'EXPLOWJSN', 'LOWALERT', 'ZIPCHECK', 'ZIPCHKLOG', 'APIZIP', 'APIMOCK', 'APILOG', 'APICFG', 'JUHTTPSV') ORDER BY OBJNAME
SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB2', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN ('ZAISRVP', 'JUCSRVP') ORDER BY OBJNAME
SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJCREATED FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN ('ZAISRV', 'JUCSRV') ORDER BY OBJNAME
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TXCKM_1004_LEFT FROM &LIB/TXCKM WHERE LESSON = '10-04'

SELECT 'JUCHUM' AS T, COUNT(*) AS N FROM &LIB/JUCHUM UNION ALL SELECT 'JUCHUD', COUNT(*) FROM &LIB/JUCHUD UNION ALL SELECT 'ZAIKOM', COUNT(*) FROM &LIB/ZAIKOM UNION ALL SELECT 'LEFTOVER-J099', COUNT(*) FROM &LIB/JUCHUM WHERE JUNO LIKE 'J099%'
